answer_1.quote: We introduce VoiceCraft-X, a single autoregressive model that unifies multilingual speech editing and zero-shot Text-to-Speech (TTS) across 11 languages.

answer_2.quote: Objectively, we use Word Error Rate (WER) as an automatic proxy for the intelligibility of the synthesized speech...

answer_4.quote: Subjective evaluations involved human annotators (see Appendix C for details) who provide Comparative Mean Opinion Scores (CMOS) and Similarity Mean Opinion Scores (SMOS) for TTS, and Naturalness Mean Opinion Scores (NMOS) and Intelligibility Mean Opinion Scores (IMOS) for speech editing.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators assess the naturalness of the synthesized speech in comparison to the ground truth (CMOS), directly score the similarity between the synthesized speech and the initial speech prompt (SMOS), and assess the naturalness and intelligibility of the synthesized and original speech (NMOS, IMOS).
